1.why: src/sylla.cpp:438, the knob speed times 2 raised to the voltage, clamped to 0.05..8

2.why: src/sylla.cpp:399-400, read as a level above 1V in gate mode and as a rising edge in trigger mode

0.why: src/sylla.cpp:524, one setVoltage of the played sample, with no stated clamp

comment: The speed jack is one volt per octave around the knob and the result is clamped to a twentieth of normal speed up to eight times, which is wider than the knob alone can reach. The engine knob's last detent is the random position and it picks only from engines in the menu's pool; the two engines that finish by themselves are excluded from that pool and can only be chosen by name. The generator library is shared with imber. The maker names Giorgio Sancristoforo's Haiku, whose material is synthesised at every launch, as the inspiration. The panel prints sylla, ENGINE, GEN, SPEED, LEN, LEVEL, LOOP, GATE, PLAY, and the jack names.
